'''''Star Wars: Jedi Academy: Leviathan''''', originally titled '''''Jedi Academy: The Leviathan of Corbos''''',<ref name="Insider35">{{InsiderCite|35|The Horse's Mouth|Straight from the Horse's Mouth}}</ref> was a four-issue series of comics published between October [[1998]] and January [[1999]] by [[Dark Horse Comics]]. The story was written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and the comic was illustrated by [[Dario Carrasco, Jr.]] and [[Mark G. Heike|Mark Heike]]. It takes place [[12 ABY/Legends|eight years]] after the fall of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and follows a group of four: [[Streen]], [[Kyp Durron]], [[Dorsk 82]] and [[Kirana Ti]].
